subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Intelligible
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intelligible"** means something that is clear and easy to understand. (सुबोध)

 
 
• **Example: **His speech was intelligible to everyone present at the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Incoherent"** refers to something that is unclear, confusing, or not logically connected. (असंबद्ध)
 
 
• **Example: **Her argument was incoherent and difficult to follow.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Intelligible'** is **'Incoherent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sociable** (मिलनसार): Willing to talk and engage in activities with other people; friendly.

 
 
• **Example:** He is a sociable person who enjoys meeting new people.
 
 
 
• **Embezzle** (गबन करना): To steal or misappropriate money placed in one's trust or belonging to the organization for which one works.
 
 
• **Example:** The accountant was found guilty of embezzling company funds.
 
 
 
• **Deliberate** (सोच समझकर किया हुआ): Done consciously and intentionally.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a deliberate attempt to discredit the politician.
